'''Stephen K. Streiffer''' (born 6 January 1966){{citation needed|date=May 2024|reason=None of existing citations mentions date of birth}} is an American materials scientist who began serving as the director of [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]] in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Stephen K. Streiffer named director of Oak Ridge National Laboratory {{!}} ORNL |url=https://www.ornl.gov/news/stephen-k-streiffer-named-director-oak-ridge-national-laboratory |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=www.ornl.gov |date=27 July 2023 }}</ref> Prior to this position, he served as interim director at [[SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=University |first=Stanford |date=2023-07-27 |title=Stephen Streiffer to depart SLAC and Stanford for Oak Ridge National Laboratory |url=https://news.stanford.edu/report/2023/07/27/stephen-streiffer-depart-slac-stanford-oak-ridge-national-laboratory/ |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=Stanford Report |language=en}}</ref> Streiffer joined [[Stanford University]] in 2022 as vice present for SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory after 24 years at [[Argonne National Laboratory]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-06-01 |title=Introducing Stephen Streiffer |url=https://lightsources.org/2022/06/01/introducing-stephen-streiffer-the-new-stanford-vp-for-slac/ |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=Lightsources.org |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Streiffer grew up in [[Baton Rouge, Louisiana]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=New Oak Ridge National Lab director emphasizes mission impact {{!}} ORNL |url=https://www.ornl.gov/news/new-oak-ridge-national-lab-director-emphasizes-mission-impact |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=www.ornl.gov |date=23 October 2023 }}</ref> In 1987, he received his bachelor's degree in materials science and engineering from [[Rice University]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Stephen K. Streiffer {{!}} UChicago Argonne LLC |url=https://www.uchicagoargonnellc.org/person/stephen-k-streiffer |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=www.uchicagoargonnellc.org}}</ref> In 1993, he completed his doctorate in materials science and engineering from [[Stanford University]].

== Career ==
Streiffer began his career at [[North Carolina State University]] as a research assistant professor.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bennet |first=Jamie |date=2023-07-31 |title=Stephen Streiffer to Assume Oak Ridge National Lab Director Post in October |url=https://executivegov.com/2023/07/stephen-streiffer-to-assume-oak-ridge-national-lab-director-post-in-october/ |access-date=2024-01-10 |language=en-US}}</ref> In 1998, he moved to [[Argonne National Laboratory]] as a researcher in the Materials Science Division.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-05-05 |title=Streiffer to lead Advanced Photon Source {{!}} Argonne National Laboratory |url=https://www.anl.gov/article/streiffer-to-lead-advanced-photon-source |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=www.anl.gov |language=en}}</ref> He was awarded the status of Fellow by the [[American Physical Society]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=APS Fellow Archive |url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=&unit_id=&institution= |access-date=2017-04-20 |website=www.aps.org |language=en}}</ref> in 2007,<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date= |title=APS Fellows 2007 |url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=&year=2007&unit_id=&institution= |archive-url= |archive-date= |access-date=2017-04-20 |website=www.aps.org |language=en}}</ref> for "experimental studies of ferroelectric thin film physics, that have established the relationships between epitaxial strain, ferroelectric phase transition behavior and domain structure, and size effects, and for advancing the fundamental understanding of complex oxide thin film microstructure."

After serving in various roles at Argonne, he became the associate laboratory director for photon sciences and director of the [[Advanced Photon Source]] in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Meet the Director: Stephen Streiffer (2015-2022) |url=https://www.energy.gov/science/articles/meet-director-stephen-streiffer-2015-2022 |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=Energy.gov |language=en}}</ref> On July 1, 2020, he was named the Argonne National Laboratory deputy director for science and technology.<ref>{{Cite web |title=APS Director Stephen Streiffer Named Argonne Deputy Lab Director for Science, Technology {{!}} Advanced Photon Source |url=https://www.aps.anl.gov/APS-News/2020-07-13/aps-director-stephen-streiffer-named-argonne-deputy-lab-director-for-science |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=www.aps.anl.gov}}</ref> From 2020 to 2022, he was also the co-director of the National Virtual Biotechnology, the [[United States Department of Energy]]'s effort to combat [[COVID-19]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Stephen K Streiffer {{!}} ORNL |url=https://www.ornl.gov/staff-profile/stephen-k-streiffer |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=www.ornl.gov}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=National Virtual Biotechnology Laboratory Unites DOE Labs Against COVID-19 |url=https://www.energy.gov/science/articles/national-virtual-biotechnology-laboratory-unites-doe-labs-against-covid-19 |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=Energy.gov |language=en}}</ref>

In June 2022, he became [[Stanford University]]’s vice president for [[SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=University |first=Stanford |date=2022-04-12 |title=Stephen Streiffer named vice president for SLAC |url=https://news.stanford.edu/report/2022/04/12/stephen-streiffer-named-stanford-vice-president-slac/ |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=Stanford Report |language=en}}</ref> During the search for a permanent director of SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory, he served as interim lab director beginning in February 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |last=University |first=Stanford |date=2023-07-27 |title=Stephen K. Streiffer named director of Oak Ridge National Laboratory |url=https://news.stanford.edu/report/2023/07/27/stephen-k-streiffer-named-director-oak-ridge-national-laboratory/ |access-date=2024-01-10 |website=Stanford Report |language=en}}</ref> In July 2023, Streiffer was announced as director of [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]] beginning on October 16.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2023-08-28|language=en|title=Stephen K. Streiffer named director of Oak Ridge National Laboratory|url=https://www.ornl.gov/news/stephen-k-streiffer-named-director-oak-ridge-national-laboratory|website=www.ornl.gov |date=27 July 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ornl.gov/staff-profile/stephen-k-streiffer |title=Stephen K Streiffer |website=ornl.gov |access-date=2025-01-02}}</ref>
